title: Carousel mobile crop, /prueba-carrusel-movil/ on a 402 px 2x phone: a <picture> with the 4/5 crop, the first with priority, no desktop preload files; the second visit serves the same crop files
description: estrategia-web/carousel with mobileRatio "4/5" and preloadSlides 2 (plugin 1.1.x, 1.4.2; includes/carousel-mobile-crop.php, includes/carousel-images.php): each is inside a with a ; at 402 px (2x) the downloaded photo is the CROP (4/5, as wide as the box asks for, not the 1536 landscape one); the first keeps fetchpriority="high"; none of the desktop preload's files is downloaded. Then a SECOND visit (at 1512) must serve the same crop files: the crop is made once, not remade under another name. Read by browser-carousel-crop-phone. It was part of ./images.mjs, run by carousel.test.mjs (level 3), until 29-10-2026.
